name: Trends.vc
tagline: Research reports on emerging markets and business ideas for founders

revenue.label: $20K MRR within a year of launch

summary: Trends.vc is a one-person research newsletter where Dru Riley publishes reports on one emerging market or trend at a time. Free readers get a summary and paid Trends Pro members get full reports and a community. He reported reaching $20K MRR in under a year.
origin: Riley quit a big-data engineering job in 2017 and spent about three years traveling and trying side products. His SaaS attempts (StrongStack, then SaaSReport) weren't making money, and he found he preferred writing about trends. He published the first Trends report on February 10, 2020.
howItMakesMoney: Trends Pro membership (full reports, databases, community); pricing has changed over time, with an annual plan listed at $299/year. Sponsorships of the free newsletter were added in February 2022.
growth: Used a fixed, recognizable report format (Problem, Players, Predictions, Opportunities, Haters, Links)
Spent 2-3 months testing the email opt-in page before scaling traffic
Two Product Hunt launches produced the biggest early jumps in subscribers
Was active on Indie Hackers and in masterminds, which spread the reports among founders
Raised prices several times as the report archive grew
moat: An archive of 100+ researched reports and a paid community of founders; the format and consistency are hard to copy quickly.
risks: AI research tools can produce passable market summaries cheaply, pressuring the value of reports. Output depends on one researcher's time.

timeline.event: Quits big-data engineering job to explore independent work
Works on StrongStack, later pivoted to SaaSReport
Starts earning revenue from Trends Pro
Tells Indie Hackers podcast he reached $20K MRR in under a year
Adds sponsorships to the free newsletter

lessons: A strict, repeatable format makes a newsletter recognizable and faster to produce
Optimize the signup page before spending effort on traffic
Sell depth to the most engaged 1-2% of readers and keep summaries free
Failed products can point to what you actually enjoy producing

rebuild.idea: A paid research newsletter on emerging opportunities in one industry vertical, e.g. independent pharmacies or small manufacturing, with supplier and regulation data
rebuild.why: General founder-trend newsletters are crowded, but owners in traditional industries lack concise research on shifts affecting them and will pay for it.
mvp: Publish 3 free reports and post them in industry groups and forums
Put a signup page up and test headlines until a clear conversion rate is found
Offer a paid tier with full data tables for $20-30/month after report 4
rebuild.fit: An analyst or consultant with background in that industry
